name: Tamaho (Japan)
description: A blue field charged at the centre with the Tamaho town emblem in white: a stylised angular device of horizontal strokes with a disc, like a stylised character.
history: Flag of the former town of Tamaho in Yamanashi Prefecture, dissolved on 2006-02-20.

features.role: Tamaho town emblem — a stylised angular device of horizontal strokes with a disc, like a stylised character
